Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…

translations.web: Then he said to me, “These are the boiling houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.”
translations.bsb: And he said to me, “These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices offered by the people.”
translations.kjv: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
translations.asv: Then said he unto me, These are the boiling-houses, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
